top_signals.title: Ukraine Strikes Major Russian Oil Refinery
top_signals.summary: It took Ukraine just hours to turn President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s “we’re done” into a refinery fire. Ukrainian drones struck Russia’s Ryazan refinery on Thursday, ending Kyiv’s brief pause in attacks on Russian energy infrastructure after Zelenskyy said Moscow had ignored the ceasefire promoted by U.S. President Donald Trump.
